run_annotation_tool_2: run the annotation_tool_2 script to print HTML for a Minecraft command annotation HIT template
render_css_script: render the CSS_SCRIPT template that hides up to 40 word spans based on variable presence
render_js_script: render the JS_SCRIPT template that shows the relevant question section by action and child name
